evidence_findings: The frozen XI averaged 9.05/11 starters; selection error still reaches Player Alpha before kickoff.
Observed match xG totals spanned 2.13-5.75, while the base forecast spanned only 2.53-3.15; the goal environment is over-compressed in this sample.
Only 3/5 route families became preferred; missing direct_transition, wide_delivery.
The best side-xG MAE among coefficient choices frozen before kickoff is zero_coefficient; this result does not fit a new coefficient or authorize a change.
